name: deepscientist-lite
description: Keep a Codex research project recoverable: record goals, routes, experiments, evidence, reviews, and next steps in local files.

interface.shortDescription: Keep research goals, experiments, evidence, and next steps easy to recover and review.
interface.longDescription: DeepScientist Lite is an independent, unofficial Codex plugin for teaching and small research projects. Seven skills help users define a project, scout evidence, compare ideas, record reproducible experiments, review claims, write bounded conclusions, and advance one visible worker iteration at a time. Local project files preserve the current route and supporting evidence across sessions. The plugin does not run a daemon, deploy models, expose an MCP server, or prove that a scientific claim is true. It is not sponsored, certified, or endorsed by ResearAI.
defaultPrompt: $ds-lite-intake turn this research question into a project with clear goals and a next step
$ds-lite-scout check the available evidence, baselines, metrics, and risks
$ds-lite-experiment define the contract first, then record this run and its evidence
$ds-lite-review check whether this experiment is ready to support an analysis
$ds-lite-iterate advance exactly one visible research iteration and stop at a checkpoint
